Name: Tiffy's Forest Meadow Farm
Author: Tiffy961
Description:
Hi there!

I decided to have a go at modding and made a Forest Farm with a River my first project. After days and days of concentrating and raging.. I think I'm done. So here it is.

Big fat credit goes to Rosalie and her amazing Enchanted Forest Map which I used as a base. 
The mod can be found here: http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/rosalies-enchanted-forest.125445/

Please note I'm still very much new to modding so things aren't perfect at all. Some parts, like the flowers by the bridge, are a bit weird if you walk too close to them and the cave door is simply for show.. you walk onto it to enter the cave.

The mod only works if you choose the Forest Farm at the start of the game!
